generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table; never NULL; strictly positive.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Sample uniformly from the parent table's generated primary-key values, excluding the reserved set of parent PKs that are never referenced (see unmatched_join_rows); never NULL (all FKs are NOT NULL).
generic_sampling_rules.integer_numeric: Uniform integer in the observed range; quantity-like columns > 0; price/amount >= 0.
generic_sampling_rules.real_numeric: Uniform real in the observed range, rounded to 2 decimals; >= 0 for prices/amounts.
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: Sample from a pool of realistic first/last names; allow near-variants (case changes, one-character edits) at ~5% of rows.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short_code: Sample from a small pool of 1-2 character codes; allow case variants.
generic_sampling_rules.text_product_name: Sample from a pool of product-like names; allow near-variants (case changes, suffix edits) at ~5% of rows.
generic_sampling_rules.nullable_text: With probability equal to the column's null_rate emit NULL; otherwise sample from the text pool. At least one NULL row per nullable column.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_values: For each column with a listed boundary literal, plant rows at the literal and one step on each side (numeric step 1 or 0.001 for reals; text case variants) by overwriting the first positions of the column in place (never prepend+truncate, so rule-corrected and duplicate-planted values are preserved). Boundary literals that violate a semantic rule of the same column (e.g. 0 for a > 0 column, negative for a >= 0 column) are NOT planted; only the rule-consistent side is planted. For FK columns, plant boundary values AFTER fill_foreign_keys_consistently so they survive.
generic_sampling_rules.duplicates_for_distinct: For DISTINCT-targeted columns, ensure 20-50% of values are duplicates of other rows.
generic_sampling_rules.ties_for_order_limit: For ORDER/LIMIT-targeted columns, plant ties at the listed ranks.
generic_sampling_rules.unmatched_join_rows: Reserve a subset of parent PKs (at least 1 per parent table, ~1-5% of parent rows) that are never drawn as FK values, so some parent rows have no child rows; child rows reference only existing, non-reserved parents (no NULL FKs since FKs are NOT NULL).
generic_sampling_rules.null_in_count_column: NOT NULL columns never get NULL; nullable columns get NULL at the observed null_rate, with at least one NULL row per nullable column (enforced by an explicit _ensure_one_null pass after all other column transforms).
